messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "A waiver was used on 2024-11-02, within the 12 months before 2025-06-15; another waiver is not allowed.", "verifier": {"reason": "The account must not have had a late fee waiver in the 12 months prior to the current date (2025-06-15). Exception: Commercial accounts (IDs starting with 'com_') may waive two late fees per 12 months. — The waiver_history shows a late fee waiver on 2024-11-02, which is within the 12-month rolling window before 2025-06-15. This violates the policy of allowing only one waiver per 12 months."}}
